create.name: Wendy Black Stern
create.bio:
Wendy Black Stern is a yoga teacher and grief guide in Boulder, Colorado, who set up the Center for Somatic Grieving. Her work grew out of the death of her son, Noah; in 2012 she started the Grief Support Network, a nonprofit offering community to the bereaved, and later built the Center to carry that work further. She has practised and taught yoga for more than twenty-five years, holds certification in Phoenix Rising Yoga Therapy, and draws on teachers such as Ram Dass and Shiva Rea.

At the Center she treats grief as something to be felt and tended rather than fixed, using yoga, breath, meditation, journaling and circle sharing to help people notice where loss lives in the body. She leads small retreats on Maui, including one that pairs grief practice with surfing and writing, online group journeys, and one-to-one sessions by Zoom. For yoga teachers, coaches, death doulas and others who hold space for loss, she runs a 200-hour Mindful Grieving yoga teacher training, offered online or as a Maui immersion, with a self-paced foundations course as the first step.

courses.title: Meet the Wave: Somatic Grief, Surf & Writing Retreat
courses.description: Six days on Maui for a small group carrying loss, combining yoga, meditation and circle time with time in the ocean and writing practice, led by Wendy.

courses.title: Mindful Grieving YTT — Maui Immersion
courses.description: The 200-hour Mindful Grieving yoga teacher training taught as eight days on Maui followed by two live online weekends, for yoga teachers, coaches, death doulas and others who support people through loss. 2027 dates are to be announced; a waitlist is open.

courses.title: Yoga & Somatic Foundations
courses.description: A 50-hour self-paced course in yoga philosophy, somatic awareness and leading safe asana practice, the prerequisite for the Mindful Grieving teacher training.

courses.title: One-on-One Somatic Grief Support
courses.description: Private sessions with Wendy that combine listening, guided meditation and Phoenix Rising yoga practices to help a person notice and move with grief held in the body. A free discovery call comes first.
